text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — planning a throughput dry run for continuous batching tuning. Need volunteers for bench runs, profiling, and a CR review to land queueing fixes. Proposed window: Thu 03/18 10:00PT. Who can take 1) benchmark harness, 2) KV cache regression checks, 3) CR LGTM + small perf test?

Kevin Patel: I can run the harness and collect perf traces. Which model/seq len?

Maya Chen: thx. Start with gpt-medium-8k @ max_tokens=1024, batch_size candidates [8,16,32], max_queue_ms=[5,20,50]. Run each config for 5min stable.

Sanjay Rao: I'll do KV cache/regression checks — will compare latency P50/P95 vs baseline. What baseline commit sha?

Maya Chen: baseline sha: a1b2c3f (main@2026-03-10). Use cb-experiments flag and include kernel traces. Example command:

```bash
./run_bench --model gpt-medium-8k --seq 2048 --max-tokens 1024 --batch-sizes 8,16,32 --queue-ms 5,20,50 --duration 300 --trace=perf,kv
```

Leah Ortiz: I can take the CR review for queueing changes. Ping me when PR is ready. small nits: add metrics tags and a test to ensure queue wait < 100ms for default.

Oliver Wu: I'll set up a dashboard panel for this run and create a route in the console to watch token/sec and queueing versions.

ci-bot: Reminder: benchmark jobs should run on dedicated-benchers; apply label bench:throughput and use bench-agent-v3.

Kevin Patel: Got it. I'll spin up benchers at 9:45 PT and post logs to /bench-results/1798213345. Will tag artifacts.

Sanjay Rao: For regression checks — I'll diff embeddings throughput too, just in case.

Leah Ortiz: CR heads-up: I'll look for code smell around locking in queue manager. If we need, we can feature-flag.

Maya Chen: Awesome — volunteers noted. Action items: Kevin run harness + traces; Sanjay run KV/regressions; Oliver dashboard; Leah CR; I'll coordinate results and schedule follow-up Fri 03/19 11:00PT. Please add your expected runtime to the thread.

Kevin Patel: Estimated 90m including traces. Posting start ts shortly.

Oliver Wu: Dashboard prep ~30m.

Sanjay Rao: Regression runs ~45m.

Maya Chen: Perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
